summary: Burst bruiser who dashes in with E, shreds armor with Q, and dodges with a decoy clone. He's strong at levels 1–5 and wins short trades with his burst. Armor, auto-dodges, and CC that catches him through his clone beat him.
threats: Q (Crushing Blow) extends his next auto's range and reduces your armor.
E (Nimbus Strike) dashes to you and gives him attack speed for the trade.
W (Warrior Trickster) dashes, turns him invisible briefly, and leaves a clone. Don't waste your spells on the clone.
R (Cyclone) at 5 spins and knocks up everyone nearby. It's his teamfight and all-in engage.

matchups.why: Wukong's damage is physical burst, which Malphite's armor and passive shield absorb, even through Q's armor shred. Malphite's E attack-speed slow cuts Wukong's E trade, and his targeted Q poke chips him every time he walks up.
trading: Q (Seismic Shard) him when he walks up to farm, then walk away with the speed.
Keep Granite Shield up before he E's in; it soaks his opening burst.
E (Ground Slam) the moment he lands E to slow his attack speed.
Don't Q his clone; wait for the real Wukong to reappear.
matchups.early: Farm safely and Q poke. Build armor early; he can't burst you through it.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R plus your jungler kills him once his W clone is down.
matchups.wave: Let him push and farm under tower; he can't dive you through armor.
matchups.jungle: Your R sets up ganks. Call when his W is down, so he can't clone away.
matchups.build: Grasp. Plated Steelcaps and early armor.

matchups.why: Counter Strike dodges Wukong's autos, which are most of his damage, and stuns him if he stays in. Jax wins every trade where E is up, and his R resists blunt Wukong's burst later.
trading: Activate E (Counter Strike) the moment he Nimbus Strikes onto you.
Leap Strike (Q) onto him after the stun to keep the trade going.
Don't trade while your E is on cooldown; his burst out-trades you then.
Don't Leap onto his clone; wait for the real Wukong to reappear.
matchups.early: Even at level 1, then favored once you have E. Trade whenever he dashes in.
matchups.spike: At 5 both R's make all-ins stronger. Keep E for his R knockup if you can.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and fight in his cooldown windows.
matchups.jungle: He escapes with W. Gank once he's used it.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Trinity Force-style bruiser items; armor boots.

matchups.why: Wukong out-bursts Darius in short trades, but Darius wins extended fights once he pulls Wukong in and stacks Hemorrhage. The lane comes down to whether Darius lands E after Wukong's W clone is used.
trading: E (Apprehend) pull him after he's used W, so he can't clone away.
Stack Hemorrhage quickly before his burst finishes.
Don't waste E or Q on his clone; wait for the real Wukong.
Hit the outer edge of Q on him to heal through his burst.
matchups.early: Even. Trade when his W is on cooldown and force long fights.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R knocks you up; your R resets on kill. Count stacks before going in.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and trade on his cooldown windows.
matchups.jungle: He escapes with W. Gank once he's used it.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Armor boots against his burst.
matchups.remember: Pull the real one, after the clone.

matchups.why: Wukong's early burst out-trades Nasus every time he walks up to stack Q, and his clone lets him escape Wither. Nasus can only farm safely and outscale with stacks and items.
trading: W (Wither) him as he E's in to slow his attack speed and his escape.
Stack Q on minions only when his E is on cooldown.
Don't Wither his clone; wait for the real Wukong to reappear.
E (Spirit Fire) the wave from range so you don't walk into his burst.
matchups.early: Give up contested creeps and farm under tower; he wins every early trade.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R gives HP and resists to survive his R all-in, but don't start fights with it.
matchups.wave: Farm under tower and stack Q on cannon minions; he can't dive you early.
matchups.jungle: Ask for an early gank when he overextends without W.
